visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white line engraving depicting a man in 19th-century attire standing in a dimly lit room. He is reaching toward a wall-mounted light fixture or gas jet, blowing a stream of air or breath toward it to ignite or extinguish it. Beside him is a wooden chair with a basket or bag containing what appears to be a skull and some feathers or foliage.
